notes: This contract records Umbra's private federation-owned input boundary for its no-TSO GALT/LITS calculator, limited TAR scheduler, and later full time-management work. A runtime-backed Join Federation Execution commits membership and its selected LogicalTime state together; a snapshot exposes the composed FDD definition plus current/pending time, role, lookahead, and zero-lookahead timestamp-boundary state for every runtime-backed member. The separate scheduler contract consumes this boundary for limited GALT/NRG TAR release. This foundation alone is not an implementation of TSO queueing, full time coordination, JUnit evidence, protected review, package support, or a conformance claim.
